products.title: Deep Groove Ball Bearing
products.excerpt: Chrome-steel deep groove ball bearings, ABEC-1 to ABEC-3, for pumps, conveyors and general machinery.
specs: Deep groove ball bearing, single row
products.body:
## Overview

Single-row deep groove ball bearings in GCr15 chrome steel for pumps, conveyors, fans and general machinery.

- ABEC-1 and ABEC-3 tolerance classes
- Open, ZZ or 2RS sealing on request
- **Mill test certificate** with every shipment

## Buyer notes

Bore sizes from 10 to 60 mm. Mixed-size cartons are available above 2,000 pcs. Please state the clearance class when ordering.

products.title: Hydraulic Hose SAE 100R2
products.excerpt: Two-wire braid hydraulic hose to SAE 100R2, working pressure to 400 bar, cut lengths or full reels.
products.body:
## Overview

Two-wire braid hydraulic hose manufactured to SAE 100R2AT and EN 853 2SN.

- Working pressure to **400 bar** at 1/2 in
- Cut lengths or full reels, your choice
- Assemblies with crimped fittings available

## Buyer notes

State the working pressure and fluid type when quoting. Orders above 2,000 m can be palletised for container loading.

products.title: Carbon Steel Weld Neck Flange
products.excerpt: ASME B16.5 weld neck flanges in carbon steel, class 150 to 300, machined and marked to spec.
products.body:
## Overview

Weld neck flanges to ASME B16.5 in ASTM A105 carbon steel, machined and marked to spec.

- Class 150 and Class 300
- **RF and FF** face options
- Heat numbers stamped on every flange

## Buyer notes

Sizes 1/2 in to 24 in. Please confirm the facing and the marking standard on your drawing before production.

products.title: AC Gear Motor 40W
products.excerpt: Single-phase AC gear motor, 40 W, ratios from 3:1 to 200:1, for packaging and conveyor drives.
products.body:
## Overview

Single-phase AC induction gear motors for packaging lines, conveyors and small machinery.

- 40 W output, ratios from 3:1 to 200:1
- 110 V / 220 V, 50 or 60 Hz
- **Terminal box** or lead-wire versions

## Buyer notes

Output speed from 7 to 500 rpm depending on ratio. Tell us the torque requirement and duty cycle when asking for a quote.

products.title: LED High Bay Light 150W
products.excerpt: 150 W industrial high bay, IP65, 140 lm/W, for warehouse and factory floor lighting.
products.body:
## Overview

150 W industrial high bay for warehouse, workshop and factory floor lighting.

- **140 lm/W** efficacy, IP65
- 60 / 90 / 120 degree optics
- 100–277 V AC input, flicker-free driver

## Buyer notes

CE and RoHS certificates supplied with each order. Mounting hooks and brackets quoted separately.

products.title: Stainless Hex Bolt A2-70
products.excerpt: A2-70 stainless hex bolts, DIN 933, M6 to M24, full or partial thread, with mill test certificates.
products.body:
## Overview

A2-70 stainless hex bolts to DIN 933 / ISO 4014 for corrosive and outdoor environments.

- **Mill test certificates** included
- M6 to M24, full or partial thread
- 304 stainless, non-magnetic finish

## Buyer notes

Priced per 1,000 pcs in standard cartons. Marking and packaging can carry your brand from 5,000 pcs.
